summary: The Day look: a third appearance from the owner's picture (light paper, green for what is live, blue for the board's wires and rings and for what is selected), chosen like the others (GRAPHITE_APPEARANCE=day, the saved setting, Rules > Desk artwork > Appearance, the look.set act); every ink measured against every Day ground (worst 4.85:1). HALT in the head's upper-left slot in every look (Day: the green triangle and the word; Graphite and Kasandra in their own stop colours), reading RESUME while her work is held, behind workbench/halt.py (press: K1's work hold, assignment.stop on the running assignment, her hand's stop, P1's moment, her column says what was stopped; release: lifts the hold, restarts nothing). Her column's gap above ACTIVE WORK is gone in every look (the exchange is as tall as its turns, the sections follow, the spare room is at the foot). In Day: Apps as the word beside the circled plus, the board's blue wires with round ends, green and blue rings and soft tile shadows, the foot's meters as words and numbers (CPU 20% | GPU — | RAM 10% | TXT —, a ▲ beside a reading near its limit). One smoke script ran on a throwaway copy, one process per look and size: 24/24 checks in Day and 20/20 in Graphite and Kasandra at 1920x1200 and 1366x768, with frames running, halted and released. Built, not tested in the owner's sense; nothing ran on the ThinkPad.

decisions: Day's colours by role: blue (AMBER_* tokens: #2a64ad edge, #dde9f7 wash, #164175 words) is what is selected and has the keyboard, so it never collides with green (READY/CUE #1a773c) for what is live, as in the picture's green state words, progress and send arrow; the chosen tab's and the foot word's underline is green (BAND_PENCIL), the keyboard's mark on a band blue. What waits for the owner is a deep orange (OWNER #a34e00), a stop red (#b42318), a recheck violet.
Day's faces: IBM Plex Sans for words, headings and the menus across the head, Plex Mono for numbers and small tags (the picture's clean sans); the Kasandra typewriter face stays Kasandra's.
Apps in Day is the word Apps beside the circled plus, as in the picture; the dark looks keep the owner's Struthio as Apps (his 0.8.6 decision) with S2's circled plus.
Glow in Day is capped at 0.6 (DAY_GLOW): on white a glow reads as a soft shadow; the dial still works in the dark looks unchanged.

HALT: the hold first (no step starts), then assignment.stop on each running assignment so its journal says 'stopped by you' with what was done; RESUME only lifts the hold (ledger.work.resume) and restarts nothing (each assignment has its own Resume, which inspects first). The button reads the work gate every 2 s, so it also reads RESUME after Stop all held her work.

HALT in the dark looks: the triangle in the look's stop colour (Graphite amber, Kasandra raspberry), the word in the band's lettering; held, in every look: a right-pointing triangle in the owner's colour, the word RESUME and a short mark under it, so colour is never alone.

Her column: a spacer after the six commands takes the room the exchange does not need; the exchange is capped at its turns' height and stretches again when its turns need more than the room; SlateFace.fold_earlier now measures the room the exchange and the spare room have together (one marked line in shell2) so a short exchange never folds its turns early.

Day meters: one line each, the key in QUIET and the reading in TEXT, '—' in FAINT with no reading, a reading near its limit in the owner's colour with ▲; '|' between them drawn midway between the words by DesktopMonitors.
The left tree's selected row keeps Graphite's eraser wash in Day (a light peach with dark words) rather than a new blue, since the tree's own module chooses it per look and it reads clearly.
